title: Cumingianols G and H, new 14,18-cycloapoeuphane triterpenoids from the Taiwan Dysoxylum cumingianum C. DC.
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,31154-31161
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03726C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Thanh Hao Huynh, Bo-Rong Peng, Chi-Jen Tai, Yu-Ting Hung, Yu-Chuan Su, Jing-Lan Hu, Jou-Hsuan Lee, Chang-Yih Duh, Jing-Ru Weng
14 compounds were isolated from Dysoxylum cumingianum, including two new 14,18-cycloapoeuphane-type triterpenoids, cumingianols G (1) and H (2). Their cytotoxic activities were evaluated against SCC2095, MCF-7, and SCM-1 cancer cell lines.
